ambient.precondition: only when ConstructionBots.BATTERY_FLEET[] !== nothing. Battery accounting is opt-in and OFF by default; calling the accessor with no fleet throws MethodError. Check it first and report `nothing` for the unmeasured case instead of letting the call throw.
